formal_lift.operator: sqrt(Delta_D) for the unit-square Dirichlet Laplacian
formal_lift.same_clock: the half-wave boundary time t in s=epsilon-i*t is unchanged

hard_gate.advance_over_c157: the full trace has a canonical epsilon^(3/2) boundary limit at every nonzero lattice shell, including times where a simple boundary pole coincides
hard_gate.required: a proved regularization/normalization theorem, not another higher-precision branch table

renormalization_theorem.coincident_poles: -1/(exp(pi*s)-1) is at worst O(epsilon^-1), so its normalized contribution is O(epsilon^(1/2)) and vanishes
renormalization_theorem.negative_time: the corresponding limit at -2*sqrt(N) is the complex conjugate
renormalization_theorem.remainder: for fixed t0 and 0<epsilon<=1, choose R with 4|m|^2>=2(t0^2+1) outside R; then |s^2+4|m|^2|>=2|m|^2, so the tail is uniformly dominated by a constant times sum |m|^-3; finitely many nonmatching shells stay bounded and all vanish after epsilon^(3/2)
renormalization_theorem.shell_multiplicity: r2_source(N)=#{m in Z^2: |m|^2=N}; this is source lattice multiplicity only
renormalization_theorem.weyl_and_constant_terms: bounded at every nonzero shell time and therefore vanish after normalization

source_lock.clock: half-wave time t under the boundary approach s=epsilon-i*t
source_lock.determinant_convention: none; clean lattice families are not isolated-orbit determinants
source_lock.forbidden_data: target zero/prime tables, target divisors/counting laws, arithmetic local or Euler factors, root numbers, automorphy, Hilbert--Polya, Route B
source_lock.normalization: epsilon^(3/2) at a nonzero source shell time t=plus_or_minus 2*sqrt(N)
source_lock.object: the C157 Dirichlet Abel half-wave trace W_D(s) on the unit square
source_lock.precision: exact lattice arithmetic and 60-decimal local branch sentinels
